text.tspan: Write specs.md: atomic tasks, models, dependencies
Acquire exclusive repository lock; validate plan
Reconcile persisted task stages and worker receipts
Retain files, commits, PRs and saved merge gate
Resume each task from its saved stage
Wait for batch outcomes; persist them
Persist exact pending merge task ids
Review and merge listed branches / PRs into main
Fetch origin/main; check git ancestry / GitHub PR state
Never accept Yes as evidence of merging
/deeep go retries or resumes the correct stage
